metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

article.title: Self-assessment.
article.content:
59Self-assessment.

Section 59  ·  Chapter XII  ·  page 61 of the Act
Every registered person shall self-assess the taxes payable under this Act and furnish a return for each tax period as specified under section 39.
